subject: Prod Inference Pilot — alignment, SLAs, access and ops next steps
messages:
From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.inference>
To: Claire Benson <claire.benson@crestline.ai>, Tom Rivera <tom.rivera@crestline.ai>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.inference>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.inference>
Date: Wed, 19 May 2027 14:03:00 -0700
Subject: Prod Inference Pilot — alignment, SLAs, access and ops next steps

Hi Claire / Tom — thanks for the time today. Quick written recap so we have a shared record and clear next steps.

Key pain points we heard:
- Latency spikes on peak queries causing timeouts for interactive workflows; p95 occasionally > 1s.
- Cost variability because current vendor autoscaling is overly conservative.
- Sensitive customer data in inference pipeline; Crestline needs stronger controls and audit logs.

Proposed pilot scope (high-level):
- Objective: validate production inference latency and cost for the document QA pipeline against your 95th/99th percentile SLAs.
- Duration: 4–6 weeks (preferred 6-week cadence to collect representative traffic).
- Success metrics: p95 < 300ms (initial), p99 < 700ms; embedding throughput target 1k reqs/min; quality: match baseline extraction F1 within 3 points.

Operational asks (what we need from Crestline):
- Sample dataset (30k anonymized docs) or a streaming test harness by 2027-05-27.
- Network access: IP allowlist + service-account key or short-lived cert for pilot cluster.
- Procurement contact for MSA/SOW: please loop in procurement@crestline.ai.
- Security: list of required compliance artifacts (SOC2, logging/audit requirements).

Redwood commitments / owners:
- Hannah (AE): commercial and timeline coordination; primary contact.
- Vanessa (CS Ops): pilot ops, access and onboarding.
- Karthik (Solutions): technical runbook, prompt/eval matrix, and sample prompts.

Attachments: pilot_scope_matrix.xlsx (attached) — contains detailed test cases, sample traffic profile, and initial eval prompts.

Next steps (agreed on call):
1) Crestline to confirm dataset approach and add procurement contact by 2027-05-21.
2) Redwood to send pilot runbook + access checklist by 2027-05-21.
3) Schedule a 30–45m ops kickoff with Crestline infra on or before 2027-05-26.

If anything above is incorrect or needs adjustment, flag it and I will update.

Thanks — looking forward to getting this moving.

—
Hannah Schmitt
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
hannah.schmitt@redwood.inference | +1 (415) 555-0123

Thanks Hannah — that aligns with our notes. A few clarifications from our side:

Confirmation / clarifications
- Dataset: we will provide a 30k anonymized sample set next week. Our engineering team prefers a streaming harness; we'll share a small runner you can hit to simulate production traffic.
- Security: our InfoSec will request SOC2 Type II attestation and a brief diagram of your audit logging (can be redacted).
- Metrics: can we capture per-request token counts and per-route cost breakdown in the pilot dashboard? That will be critical for procurement evaluation.

Procurement / legal
- Looping in procurement@crestline.ai for SOW/MSA. They will need an initial SOW and an estimated cost range for the 6-week pilot.

People:
- Engineering lead on our side: Tom Rivera (cc'd). He will coordinate the sample harness and env access.

Proposed dates
- Ops kickoff: May 26, 2027 — morning PT preferred. Please propose two time slots.
- We would like a short security sync with your SecOps before kickoff if possible.

Attachments: I am attaching crestline_requirements.pdf which lists our baseline compliance and network requirements.

Thanks,

Hi Claire / Tom — adding the technical plan and timeline below. Attaching the pilot_runbook.md and a link to a one-click SOW DocuSign for the engagement.

Technical plan & timeline (high-level)
- Week 0 (prep, May 26–28): access provisioning, IP allowlist, confirm service-account and test harness connectivity. Security sync (30m) during Week 0.
- Week 1 (baseline): deploy model variant, run baseline traffic for 48 hours to capture p95/p99.
- Weeks 2–4 (scale & eval): apply realistic traffic mix, run prompt set, and collect cost/latency/quality metrics.
- Week 5 (finalize): compile eval report, remediation plan, and go/no-go recommendation.

Deliverables
- Pilot runbook (attached): step-by-step onboarding, model config, prompt suite, and required logs.
- Eval matrix (embedded in runbook): acceptance criteria and how we measure quality against your baseline.
- SOW: DocuSign link — sow_docusign_link.url (attached).

Open asks from Crestline (action items)
1) Confirm sample dataset or streaming harness by EOD 2027-05-27 so we can provision the pilot cluster.
2) Confirm one of these ops kickoff windows on May 26: 09:00–09:45 PT or 11:00–11:45 PT.
3) Procurement: if you can provide target budget or range, we will prepare a pilot SOW estimate.
